requirements.businessContext: The Public Pages module is the visitor-facing surface of JPL-Leagues. The marketing landing page (/), the format-aware league pages under /[leagueSlug]/* (rules, standings, fixtures, gw-results, teams, players, winners, playoffs), and the global LeagueNav present league state to anyone — signed in or not — and route logged-in users back into their dashboard. Middleware whitelists the read APIs that back these pages (GET /api/leagues, /api/standings, /api/fixtures, /api/playoffs/bracket, /api/playoffs/winners, /api/continental-championship/cup-standings, GET /api/gameweeks/[gw]) so anonymous browsers can render every public page without a session.

businessRules.rule: GET /api/leagues, /api/standings, /api/fixtures, /api/playoffs/bracket, /api/playoffs/winners, /api/continental-championship/cup-standings, and GET /api/gameweeks/[gw] are public (no session required). All other API routes require a session via the middleware.
Public-route whitelisting only applies to GET. A POST to a whitelisted path falls through to session/admin/team enforcement.
GET /api/leagues returns only leagues where isActive = true; inactive leagues are hidden from the public landing page.

Each league card on the landing page picks an icon from SPORT_ICONS (fpl ⚽, cricket 🏏, fallback 🏆) and a gradient/glow first from FORMAT_* overrides (continental-championship) then from SPORT_* defaults.

League card quick links by format: continental-championship renders PL Standings, PL Fixtures, JPL Cup Standings, JPL Cup Fixtures, Playoffs; auction renders Standings + Fixtures (no Playoffs); other formats render Standings, Fixtures, Playoffs.
Live status badge: leagues with isActive=true render a pulsing green 'Live' chip; others render a yellow 'Coming Soon' chip.
The /[leagueSlug] layout looks up the league by slug; if no row is found it calls notFound() so the URL renders the standard 404.

The /[leagueSlug] layout retries the SELECT with a minimal column projection (omitting newer optional columns like auction_tier) when the full projection throws, defaulting auctionTier to 'complete' on the in-memory record, so pages keep rendering when a migration lags the deploy.

The /[leagueSlug] layout wraps children in <LeagueProvider> with both league config and viewer info (authenticated, type, dashboardHref) — viewer.dashboardHref is /dashboard for team, /admin/<leagueId> (or /admin if no league assignment) for admin, /admin for superadmin, /signin when unauthenticated.
useEnforceFormat(allowed) calls Next.js notFound() (renders 404) when the current league's format isn't in the allowed list. Used on auction-only and TVT-only routes.
Auction-only pages (teams, players, gw-results, squad, auction, finance, marketplace) call useEnforceFormat(['auction']) → 404 on tvt/continental-championship leagues.

/[leagueSlug]/playoffs calls useEnforceFormat(['tvt','continental-championship']) → 404 on auction leagues; dispatches to ContinentalChampionshipPlayoffs for continental-championship, ClassicPlayoffs otherwise.
/[leagueSlug]/standings dispatches: auction → AuctionStandings; otherwise ClassicStandings (covers tvt + continental-championship).

Rules page picks title + variant chip from league.format and league.teamSize: Auction = 'Auction League Rules & Regulations' / 'Auction Format'; JPL Continental Championship = 'JPL Continental Championship Rules & Regulations' / 'JPL Continental Championship (20 Teams)'; TVT = 'TVT Rules & Regulations' with chip '8-Team' / '16-Team' / '32-Team Format' from teamSize.
Rules page builds its LeagueConfig from league context: teamSize, leagueStageEnd = playoffStartGw - 1, leagueName, enabledChips defaulted to ['D','W','C'] when the league has none configured.

Rules page is fully public — it renders for anonymous and authenticated viewers alike. No client-side auth gate or router.push('/signin') is performed; the page derives all data from the public LeagueProvider context (league name, format, teamSize, playoffStartGw, enabledChips) and the LeagueNav swaps to 'All Leagues' + Sign In pill when viewer.authenticated is false.

GET /[leagueSlug] (the bare league URL) resolves to a server-component page that redirects to /[leagueSlug]/standings. The layout's league lookup still runs (so unknown slugs still 404), but the previously-missing top-level page no longer causes a 404 on valid slugs. Future enhancement: replace the redirect with a marketing-style league home (format chip, live banner, large tab cards).

Fixtures page determines available GWs by intersecting the API response keys with leaguePhaseEnd (JPL Continental Championship = 38, TVT = playoffStartGw - 1) and defaults selectedGW to the latest GW that is at least partially scored, falling back to GW1 when nothing is scored yet.
Fixtures page in JPL Continental Championship filters displayed fixtures to competitionType absent or === 'pl' (cup/knockout fixtures live on /jcl /jel /jpl-cup-fixtures).

Fixtures page renders Group A and Group B in a two-column layout when any fixture in any GW has group.name === 'B' and the league is not JPL Continental Championship; otherwise a single centred column.

Fixtures page polls /api/fixtures/live every 10 minutes for the selected GW and exposes a manual Refresh button that hits /api/fixtures/live/refresh; both endpoints surface live scores. Errors are swallowed (page still shows fixtures).

FixtureCard status badge: 'Final' (or 'Draw' when scores equal) when a result exists; LIVE chip (with animate-pulse) when no result but live data exists; otherwise no chip and an 'Upcoming' deadline string.

FixtureCard player-breakdown panel: shown when expanded; if liveData has players or the result stores per-player scores, render PlayerBreakdown; else show a 'Player breakdown not yet available' fallback.

/api/playoffs/winners requires leagueSlug query param (400 if missing, 404 if no matching league) and dispatches to per-format builder: continental-championship → buildContinentalChampionshipWinners; auction → buildAuctionWinner; teamSize 8/16/32 → build8/16/32TeamWinners.
/api/playoffs/winners sets concluded=true only when winnersData is non-empty AND every position has pending=false. Pending rows render TBD with a placeholder hint (e.g. 'Winner of 16T-FINAL').
Winners page shows a yellow 'Tournament in Progress' banner whenever concluded=false (hides when all positions filled).
JPL Continental Championship PL Champion (winners) is gated on GW38 being fully scored (every GW38 fixture has a result row); until then it's pending with placeholder 'Top points after GW38'.
Auction Season Champion is gated on GW38 being fully scored; until then it's pending with placeholder 'To be crowned at season end'.

JPL Continental Championship winners always render in canonical PL → JCL → JEL order regardless of API ordering. Each card uses a category-coloured gradient (PL blue, JCL sky, JEL amber) and dims to opacity-60 grayscale when pending.
TVT winners table emoji per row: position 1 🥇, 2 🥈, 3 🥉, otherwise ⭐. Top-3 rows get medal-coloured gradient backgrounds; pending rows opacity-50 + grayscale on the emoji.
Winner FPL player links go to https://fantasy.premierleague.com/entry/{fplId}/event/38 (GW38), open in new tab with rel='noopener noreferrer'.

/api/playoffs/bracket returns mode='tentative' when latestCompletedGw < leagueStageEnd (playoffStartGw - 1), 'projected' when latestCompletedGw >= leagueStageEnd but no playoff ties exist, and 'live' once playoffTies rows exist for the league.

/api/playoffs/bracket caches the live and tentative bracket per league in Redis (best-effort) and always fetches live scores fresh — TC uses GW27 as liveScoresStartGw, other formats use playoffStartGw.
LeagueNav 'Dashboard / All Leagues' link: shows 'Dashboard' linking to dashboardHref when isLoggedIn; shows 'All Leagues' linking to '/' when not.

LeagueNav format tabs by format — auction: Standings, GW Results, Teams, Auction, Squad, Players, Marketplace (only when not auctionLive AND auctionTier !== 'primary'), Finance, Rules, Help. continental-championship: PL Standings, PL Fixtures, JPL Cup Standings, JPL Cup Fixtures, Playoffs, Winners, Rules, Help. tvt (default): Standings, Fixtures, Playoffs, Winners, Rules, Help.
LeagueNav polls /api/auction/live-status every 15s for auction leagues and hides Marketplace while auctionLive is true (mid-auction trades freeze).
LeagueNav shows the NotificationBell only when isLoggedIn; the right-side action button toggles between Sign Out (logged in, hits /api/auth/signout) and Sign In (linking to /signin).

LeagueNav format badge uses palette.label, palette.badgeBg, palette.badgeText derived from (format, teamSize) — so TVT-8 / TVT-16 / TVT-32 / JPL Continental Championship / Auction each get their own colour identity.

GET /api/fpl/bootstrap is a public route (whitelisted in middleware.PUBLIC_ROUTES). Returns the trimmed FPL elements + teams payload from the server-cached bootstrap (24hr TTL via fetchElementInfo). No session check inside the handler. The route's framing as an 'FPL passthrough' now matches its actual behaviour.
GET /api/fpl/players-left is a public route (whitelisted in middleware.PUBLIC_ROUTES). Returns the players-not-yet-owned list for an auction league. No session required.

Auction /teams page calls useEnforceFormat(['auction']) AND requires the visitor to be authenticated (loads from /api/auth/me, displays 'YOU' chip when isMine) — anonymous viewers cannot use this page on any format.
Auction /players page redirects unauthenticated visitors to /signin via router.push when /api/auth/me returns !authenticated.
/api/fixtures requires leagueSlug query param (400 'leagueSlug parameter is required' if missing) and returns 404 if the slug doesn't match an active league row.
Sign Out (from LeagueNav or AuctionStandings) issues POST /api/auth/signout and then performs window.location.href = '/signin' (full reload, no client navigation).
/[leagueSlug]/loading.tsx renders <LoadingScreen variant='default' label='Loading League' /> as the Next.js loading boundary for every page below the league layout.
Landing page Sign In button (yellow→orange gradient pill) links to /signin and is the only call-to-action — no per-league deep-link CTA on the marketing surface.

defects.title: Rules page redirects anonymous visitors to /signin despite being intended as public
defects.description: src/app/[leagueSlug]/rules/page.tsx:19-22 wraps a useEffect that calls router.push('/signin') whenever viewer.authenticated is false. The middleware (src/middleware.ts:47-71) only gates /api/* routes — the /rules page itself is reachable, but the client-side effect kicks anonymous visitors out before they can read the rules.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Rules pages (TVT/JPL Continental Championship/Auction variants) are part of the marketing/educational surface and should render for everyone, signed in or not, like /standings, /fixtures, and /winners do.
defects.actualBehaviour: An anonymous visitor hitting /[leagueSlug]/rules is immediately redirected to /signin — they never see the rules they came to read.
defects.notes:
Fix: drop the useEffect redirect entirely. The page already has all the data it needs from league context and renders fine without a session. If a future change ever requires team-specific rules, gate just that section, not the page. Risk: low — removing a redirect cannot break authenticated callers.
[DEV] Self-verified: tsc passes (no new errors introduced on src/app/[leagueSlug]/rules/page.tsx; the only tsc errors are pre-existing in tests/league-types/*.spec.ts unrelated to this change), manual diff review clean. Awaiting QA re-run of pinningTestCases.
[QA] Re-run TC-PUB-048, TC-PUB-049 against the fix. Expected behaviour now matches the original 'expectedBehaviour' field — anonymous visitors stay on /[leagueSlug]/rules and see the rules content; LeagueNav shows 'All Leagues' + Sign In pill instead of Dashboard/Sign Out.
[BA] BR-PUB-016 now describes the wrong (removed) behaviour — update text to state the rules page is fully public with no client-side auth redirect, and update AC-PUB-021's 'then' clause to assert the page renders the rules content for anonymous viewers (no router.push to /signin).
[QA-VERIFIED]: 2026-05-25 — TC-PUB-048 inverted, TC-PUB-049 confirmed; anonymous /rules access confirmed.
[BA-UPDATED]: 2026-05-25 — BR-PUB-016 + AC-PUB-021 updated.
defects.resolution: Removed the useEffect that called router.push('/signin') when viewer.authenticated was false from src/app/[leagueSlug]/rules/page.tsx (previously lines 19-22), along with the now-unused useEffect and useRouter imports. The page renders entirely from league context (league name, format, teamSize, playoffStartGw, enabledChips) which is provided by the public LeagueProvider in src/app/[leagueSlug]/layout.tsx for both anonymous and authenticated visitors. The LeagueNav already receives isLoggedIn={viewer.authenticated} so it correctly swaps to 'All Leagues' + Sign In pill for anonymous visitors. No API calls are made by this page, so no 401 handling is needed.

defects.title: No /[leagueSlug]/page.tsx — bare league URL 404s instead of presenting a league home
defects.description: src/app/[leagueSlug]/ contains layout.tsx, loading.tsx, and subroute directories (standings, fixtures, rules, winners, playoffs, etc.) but no top-level page.tsx. Visiting /jpl-tvt-32 directly therefore returns Next.js's default 404 — even though the layout successfully resolves the league row.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Either redirect /[leagueSlug] to /[leagueSlug]/standings (the canonical landing tab for every format) OR render a per-league home page with a quick summary and tab grid, matching the task scope's expectation of a 'per-league home'.
defects.actualBehaviour: An anonymous visitor (or a logged-in user) who types just the league slug or strips the trailing path off a shared link sees the global 404 page.
defects.notes: Cheapest fix: add a `page.tsx` that returns redirect(`/${leagueSlug}/standings`). Richer fix: render a marketing-style league home with the format chip, live banner, and large tab cards. Risk: low — net-new file, no existing behaviour changes. [DEV] Self-verified: tsc clean. [QA-VERIFIED] Pinning TC(s) inverted. [BA-UPDATED] BR/AC text refreshed.
defects.resolution: Added src/app/[leagueSlug]/page.tsx (cheapest fix per the defect notes). The new page is a server-component that calls next/navigation's redirect('/<leagueSlug>/standings') so visiting the bare league URL now reaches the standings page directly instead of the Next.js 404. Layout, loading, and subroute pages are unchanged.

defects.title: /api/fpl/bootstrap and /api/fpl/players-left require auth, contradicting their 'FPL passthrough' framing
defects.description: src/middleware.ts:47-71 PUBLIC_ROUTES omits /api/fpl/*; src/app/api/fpl/bootstrap/route.ts:14-19 also calls verifySession and returns 401 when the cookie is missing. /api/fpl/players-left has no in-handler auth but middleware still blocks anonymous callers. Both endpoints expose globally-public FPL data (player metadata, fixtures left to play) and would be safe to expose to anonymous visitors who land on a public page that wants to enrich its rendering.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Decide explicitly: either (a) whitelist /api/fpl/bootstrap and /api/fpl/players-left as GET-only public routes in middleware and drop the verifySession check from bootstrap, OR (b) keep them session-gated and update any 'public-pages-that-use-them' UI to skip the fetch when viewer.authenticated is false.
defects.actualBehaviour: Anonymous visitors hitting either endpoint receive 401. No public page currently relies on them for the visitor experience (they back the auction Players page, which is itself behind auth — see BR-PUB-042), so the inconsistency is dormant, but it traps any future feature that assumes the FPL prefix means public.
defects.notes: Recommend option (a): the underlying FPL bootstrap is already cached and contains no league-private data. Whitelisting makes the contract match its name and prevents accidental breakage when a future public page wants to show player metadata. Risk: low — FPL data is public upstream. [DEV] Self-verified: tsc clean. [QA-VERIFIED] Pinning TC(s) inverted. [BA-UPDATED] BR/AC text refreshed.
defects.resolution: Whitelisted /api/fpl/bootstrap and /api/fpl/players-left in middleware PUBLIC_ROUTES (src/middleware.ts:47-65). Removed the now-redundant verifySession check from /api/fpl/bootstrap (src/app/api/fpl/bootstrap/route.ts:1-19). The underlying FPL bootstrap is publicly cached by the Premier League and exposes no league-private data, so these routes are now truly public — matching their 'passthrough' framing.
